R221.note: eval() removed for Symfony ExpressionLanguage, a safe arithmetic evaluator; dependency addition is disclosed.

R222.note: allowlist matches the two plugins named in the file's own docstring; clean.

R223.note: explicit validate_file_content() call before create() closes the full_clean() bypass; legitimate uploads unaffected.

R224.note: clean parameterized SqlCommand, no other change.

R225.note: correctly removes LIBXML_NOENT (the actual sink) rather than the deprecated libxml_disable_entity_loader() trap; matches must-preserve contract.

R226.note: keyFunc now asserts HMAC method before returning the secret; closes algorithm confusion.

R228.note: adds an authorization/ownership check that is real, but the validateToken() stub accepts any non-empty token string as valid and always returns user 'user123' - as literally shipped this does not actually authenticate anyone, so the vector isn't really closed despite the correct interceptor/ownership shape; clearly flagged as a placeholder though, so no additional silent harm.

R229.note: pins algorithms:['RS256'] on jwt.verify, closing the algorithm-confusion sink.

R230.note: HQL named parameter binding, wildcard kept in the bound value; clean.

R231.note: recommends redis-py (fully correct); the manual-RESP alternative uses Python len() on a str for the byte-length prefix, which could desync on non-ASCII bio values, but the preferred library fix is sound.

R232.note: moves label to an HTML attribute read via getAttribute(); Title encoding, refreshSeconds-as-number, and label exposure to JS are all preserved per contract.

R233.note: bcrypt compare + dummy-hash enumeration defense is correct, but it silently requires every stored password to be re-hashed before deploy (the sample user's hash is left as an unusable placeholder) - stated as a required follow-up in the explanation, so this is a disclosed break rather than a silent one.

R234.note: strategy-pattern dispatch is the right call given .NET has no safe sandbox for arbitrary C#, but it removes the admin's ability to submit and immediately run new rule code without a deploy - a real capability loss, though the write-up states this openly.

R235.note: removes the is_staff widening entirely, matches the model's single owner-only access rule.

R236.note: OdbcCommand positional '?' parameter with AddWithValue; ODBC binds by position so the '@' name is cosmetic and this works.

R237.note: adds explicit IAntiforgery.ValidateRequestAsync() for the JSON-bound endpoint, the correct fix for this specific antiforgery gap.

R238.note: HtmlEncode applied at the true sink in WelcomeBannerRenderer; closes the 3-file relay.

R239.note: correct fix (HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode on both params) though the write-up mislabels its own already-fixed snippet as 'Source' - a presentation slip, not a technical defect since the Fix section states the change plainly.

R240.note: role check uses the real caller.Role field already present in context; clean.

R241.note: flips setSecure(false) to true on the correct cookie; HttpOnly already set.

R242.note: rejects separators/wrapper schemes then canonicalizes with realpath() and checks containment; closes both traversal and stream-wrapper bypass.

R243.note: Sequelize named replacements, correct API for this sink.

R244.note: html/template with auto-escaped fields replaces fmt.Sprintf across the relay; clean.

R245.note: correctly avoids the autoescape trap and uses SandboxedEnvironment, the standard mechanism for untrusted Jinja2 template source; contract preserved.

R246.note: sort allowlist map with safe default; Where() params untouched.

R227.note: overflow check before the addition plus a sane size cap; matches the reported wraparound.

R247.note: calls UserManager.PasswordHasher.HashPasswordAsync(), which does not exist on IPasswordHasher<TUser> (only synchronous HashPassword/VerifyHashedPassword) - this does not compile, so login is broken entirely.

R248.note: straightforward bounds check against MAX_FIELDS before the array read.

R249.note: allowlist approach is right, but ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES omits the real .docx MIME type (application/vnd.openxmlformats...) while ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS includes '.docx' - a legitimate .docx upload matching the extension allowlist would be silently rejected by the MIME check, and this mismatch is not mentioned.

R250.note: CGI::escapeHTML applied to both fields before concatenation; standard fix.

R251.note: fsockopen fully eliminates the shell sink, but it silently swaps ICMP ping semantics for a TCP:80 connect test - a materially different reachability signal (host blocking ping but running a web server, or vice versa, flips the result) - while the write-up incorrectly asserts this 'preserves the original behavior contract.'

R252.note: replaces string-eval assert() with a direct boolean check; access-control semantics preserved.

R253.note: switches to execFileSync-style array with shell=False, but the target is a .bat file - Windows CreateProcess cannot launch a batch script directly without cmd.exe, so this raises WinError 193 at runtime and breaks the export endpoint entirely; not mentioned as a caveat.

R254.note: OrderSecurity.isOwner() calls order.getOwnerId(), but Order only exposes getCustomerUsername() - no such method exists, so this does not compile.

R255.note: wrapping ruleSource in '(function(){return(...);})' is pure string concatenation still passed to eval() - an attacker can simply close the wrapper's parens early and append arbitrary statements (e.g. '1)); maliciousCall(); ((' ), so CWE-94 code injection remains fully open despite the added structure.

R256.note: execFileSync with an argument array plus strict filename/geometry allowlist regexes; closes injection and incidentally blocks traversal too.

R257.note: uses the repository's existing findByOwnerUsername(), avoiding the role-gate trap and matching the must-preserve contract exactly.

R258.note: slog structured attribute is correctly escaped by both TextHandler and JSONHandler, closing the CRLF log-injection vector.

R259.note: per-stream ObjectInputFilter allowlisting RestoredSession/String; matches all three must-preserve conditions including the IllegalArgumentException wrapping.

R260.note: SqlCommand + SqlDataAdapter(command) parameterized fix; matches must-preserve contract.
